Class PaintingsEvent

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.model.cards.TribeCard
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.model.cards.events.EventCard
it.polimi.gc06.mesos.model.cards.events.PaintingsEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Card, Serializable
public class PaintingsEvent extends EventCard
Represents the Cave Paintings Event card. The player gains prestige if they have enough artists, or loses prestige if they fall below the minimum requirement.

    • resolveEvent

      public void resolveEvent(Player player)
      This method is used to resolve the event card: takes the number of ARTISTS for every player and if it's greater than the minNumberOfArtists on the card remove prestige tokens from the player; otherwise add prestige tokens for every artist in the deck multiplied by the prestige on the card.
      Specified by:
      resolveEvent in class EventCard
      Parameters:
      player - The player that is resolving the event.
